id.description: This is the unique identifier for the personality.

orgId.description:
This is the unique identifier for the organization this personality belongs to.
If null, this is a Vapi-provided default personality available to all organizations.

createdAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the personality was created.

updatedAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the personality was last updated.

name.description: This is the name of the personality (e.g., "Confused Carl", "Rude Rob").

assistant.description:
This is the full assistant configuration for this personality.
It defines the tester's voice, model, behavior via system prompt, and other settings.

path.description:
Optional folder path for organizing personalities.
Supports up to 3 levels (e.g., "dept/feature/variant").
Maps to GitOps resource folder structure.
